title: Thai Rice and Flatbread
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread served with a side of steamed Thai-inspired rice. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Cook the Thai jasmine rice according to the package instructions.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the flatbread with sesame oil and grill for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and honey.
In a separate bowl, mix together sliced mango, red onion, and chopped cilantro.
Assemble the flatbread by spreading a spoonful of the mango mixture on each piece, followed by a drizzle of the soy sauce mixture.
Top with sliced fresh chilies and serve with a side of steamed Thai jasmine rice.
